Walked out after 30 Minutes
Apr 2019 • Couples
Recommend to eat here by our hotel, so they booked us a table and the complimentary taxi arrived to take us there. On arrival we were seated at our table overlooking the bay and given a glass of water.

That was then it.

No service or anyone coming to even ask us for a drink for 30 minutes (let alone asking us what food we wanted to order!!)

Staff were just too busy looking at their phones and ignoring us.

From what we saw on the menu, this would have been our most expensive dinner in Nha Trang, but not having the chance to order we cannot give you a firm comment there.
Read more
Written April 24, 2019
Tong D
We are very sorry for this situation. Normally we like to give people some time to read through the menu and make their choices. Once people make their choices they normally call the waiter/waitress to come and take their order. We did not recieve any such signal from you, so we thought that maybe you were waiting for some friends to come before ordering together. It was all a big misunderstanding and we are truly sorry for your experience. In future we will try and make sure our staff do not always wait for some signal, but go up and ask our customers what they would like after a certain amount of time. Thank you for your review and we hope you have a good stay in Vietnam.

Nice view but left very unsatisfied
Dec 2018 • Couples
Went to MP with high expectation. Restaurant manager arranged transportation from hotel to restaurant. The view from our table was good, beautiful view of Nha Trang in the middle and constructions left and right.

We order lobster sashimi + lobster congee, mantis shrimps, clams, curry crab and 2 beers. Bill came to 3.6 million dong. It’s very expensive in Nha Trang standard and the food most definitely didn’t match.

The lobster congee was really bad, tasted like frozen lobster. I reported to the manager and he said there was something wrong with the elevator that night and kitchen made a mistake. I just don’t understand how an elevator could contribute to the freshness of a lobster.

Anyways, my advice... stay away. Your 3.6 million dong is better spent elsewhere!
Read more
Written December 20, 2018
Tong D
Hi Farandl 2016, thank you for your kind review.
We are sorry that you did not like the taste of our lobster congee. We guarantee all our lobsters are fresh. We picked a live lobster out of our tank to make lobster sashimi and lobster congee that day. We never use frozen lobster.
 We are sincerely sorry for the on-going construction next door, it should be done soon.
 Again, sorry for your disappointment, we will strive to serve you better in the future. Have a nice day.

Best seafood I had in Vietnam!

AMAZING FOOD
Aug 2018 • Couples
The MP Thai Seafood restaurant is a 10 minute walk from the Amiana hotel where we are staying. The restaurant offers a complimentary vehicle to drop you off or pick you up on request. We received a very friendly greeting and the staff spoke English very well. The service was impeccable with staff ensuring your water glass was kept filled at all times. The drinks menu is extensive. Best of all was the food. We have travelled to Thailand many times but the food served at the MP Seafood restaurant was the best Thai food we have ever tasted. This restaurant is a must for anyone who loves Thai food. We will be going back there again tomorrow.
